hook: The Times told photographers: skip the Photoshop update.
hookText: NYT bans new Photoshop for photographers

beats.say: The New York Times is asking freelance photographers not to install Photoshop 2027, because its new AI features work in ways that may not be apparent to users.
The worry is metadata. The update can tag photos as AI-generated, even after routine edits, and for a newsroom that keeps editing minimal, that risks readers' trust.
Adobe's November update adds an AI Assisted Editor view, an editing assistant, prompt-based transforms, new upscaling, and a tool that recomposes images for different canvas sizes.
